correct_alts:
Flaky test_sync_roundtrip on CI
- It times out waiting for the mock broker roughly one run in twelve, and never on a laptop.
- The flakiness began when the runner image moved to two vCPUs.
- Please add a readiness wait or a fixed port instead of lengthening the timeout.

test_sync_roundtrip intermittently times out
On CI the test hangs about 1 run in 12 while it connects to the mock broker. It only began after the runners dropped to 2 vCPUs. The fix should wait for broker readiness. Raising the timeout would only hide it.

Title: Flaky test_sync_roundtrip on CI

The test fails about 1 run in 12 with a timeout waiting for the mock broker. It passes locally and started after the runner image moved to 2 vCPUs. It is not related to the retry decorator work. Prefer a fixed port or a readiness wait over a bigger timeout.
